# `aitbc genesis init`

Retired — cannot produce the canonical bc-2 genesis; use scripts/ops/build-genesis.py. This command drives the legacy unified_genesis.py builder, whose output a bc-2 node would not accept (no canonical state_root or bridge-validator digest). It now refuses before reading or writing any file. The only builder is apps/blockchain-node/src/aitbc_chain/ genesis_builder.py, driven by scripts/ops/build-genesis.py — see docs/deployment/bc2-consumers.md.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc genesis init [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID for genesis (auto-detected from config if not provided) |
| `--create-wallet` | flag | `false` | no | Create the treasury (genesis) wallet with a secure random key |
| `--proposer` | text | — | no | Proposer address (defaults to the treasury wallet) |
| `--force` | flag | `false` | no | Force overwrite existing genesis |
| `--register-service` | flag | `false` | no | Register the treasury (genesis) wallet with the wallet service |
| `--service-url` | text | `http://localhost:8108` | no | Wallet service URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc genesis init
```
